propositions: Version 0.12.0 must be bumped consistently across pyproject.toml, server.json, and uv.lock before release
CHANGELOG.md curated [Unreleased] section must be retitled to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 with fresh [Unreleased] and updated compare links
Release commit requires DCO sign-off, Gerrit Change-Id, and rebar-ticket trailer; must pass Gerrit LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and submit to main without unresolved comments
release.yml workflow must dispatch from main with version=0.12.0, pass all 10 jobs, obtain pypi environment approval, and publish artifacts to PyPI, GitHub, MCP Registry, and Homebrew
Published nava-rebar 0.12.0 must pass PEP 740 attestation verification, confirm tag v0.12.0 on main, and pass channel smoke test (pipx install + probe_rebar.py)
